metadata.description: The session can run on any model: GPT-6.1 Sol (via Codex) handles delegated implementation at a per-task reasoning effort while the architect makes small, local changes directly, Claude Sonnet takes over when Sol is unavailable, and every deliverable is reviewed in a clean context: by Claude Opus for routine lane work, and by Fable for consults, the architect's own changes, and high-risk work.
